::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 20th [1878 or later]  
**From:** Torre Villa Yealmpton  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Mr Beck](people/person_132.qmd)

I hear that the Warden and the Echeverias have safely reached Otterbourne.[^1]

Thank you very much for them

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This was the home of Mary Yonge after her father’s death in August 1877.
[^2]: The person most likely to be the one thanked here seems to be the Rev. James Beck (b. 1819/20), Rector of Parham, Sussex, and subsequently of Bildeston, Suffolk, who had married (1867) Caroline Jeannette (Bignell) Walter, stepmother of Gertrude Walter.  The 'Warden' was probably a pear tree.
